name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateEngineAudio
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 008252C0..0082544B, 128 instructions, no flow gaps. First of the three timed sub-updates 008255B0 calls at 00825D5A. Gate: byte +9C4h (008252CA). Selects one of three 0x24-apart settings blocks in the 00424C40 singleton by IsKindOf: 0Eh -> +5E0h, 8 -> +604h, else +5BCh; only +8 in the block is read, the smoothing rate. Then 0042AC60(&f_BC4h, byte_5Dh ? 0 : fabsf(f_980h), rate*delta). Pushes f_BC4h as the parameter 'rpm' (00D08688) into the emitters at +BBCh and +BB8h through vtable +1Ch, and 0092D730(controller)/0080FC30(this) as 'param00' (00D09998) into +BB4h with no clamp and no zero guard. Calls vtable +0Ch (0.0f) on +BC0h only while +5Dh is set. No position, heading or speed integration. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 008255B0..00825DD4, 521 instructions, no flow gaps, SEH handler 00C91888. Reached as unit vtable slot 0DCh from 00904BF0, which the in-mission subsystem update 004C40A0 calls as world->vtable[0Ch] with game+21F0h. Twelve steps in listing order: submerged effect cull over +758h/+75Ch against -0.5; underwater bubble timer at +BC8h; the +1010h/+1011h edge latch; 00815AA0 with a 0/1 scalar; bow and stern water anchors through 00413920 and the ocean sampler 0078CF20; 0092BE80 and 0081C050; the intensity product at +10A4h (0.5 when this == DAT_00E188D8); the wake spawn; the prop wash at +1170h; five attachment anchors at +B54h/+B68h; 008252C0, 00956600 and 00834E90 with the delta; then every part in the vector at +A14h/+A18h. docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_ShipIdleRecord_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Default-constructs the 1Ch-byte ship Idle record: the templates weight map at +0h, the anims weight map at +0Ch and the posID slot at +18h. Evidence: BSP_ShipClass_ReadLuaFields 00831840 calls it at 0083306A on a 1Ch-byte stack temp (SUB ESP,0x1c at 00833059) that 0082F8E0 then copies into the vector at descriptor+6FCh, and the reader writes exactly those three offsets (00499030 at record+0h, 00444BE0 at record+0Ch, posID-1 at 008330E3). Provisional: the two map types were not decoded.

name: BSP_ShipClass_ResizeIdleRecords
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Resizes the ship descriptor's Idle record vector at descriptor+6FCh, filling new elements from a 1Ch-byte prototype. Evidence: BSP_ShipClass_ReadLuaFields 00831840 calls it at 0083307C with ECX = descriptor+6FCh (ADD ESI,0x6fc at 00833074) after 0082E1F0 constructs the prototype at 0083306A, and reads the new element as end-1Ch. Also called by 0082FE30. Provisional: the growth policy was not decoded.

name: BSP_ShipClass_ResizeTrafficRecords
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Resizes the ship descriptor's Traffic record vector at descriptor+6DCh to the requested count, filling new elements from a 50h-byte prototype the caller built on the stack. Evidence: its only caller is BSP_ShipClass_ReadLuaFields 00831840 at 00832ECB, where 0049F9B0 default-constructs the 50h-byte prototype at 00832EBC, ECX is descriptor+6DCh (LEA at 00832E79) and the loop index is pushed; the caller then reads the new last element as end-50h through the +6E0h/+6E4h begin and end pointers. Provisional: the growth policy inside was not decoded.
